_comment: Hand-labelled ground truth. `live` is the answer a careful reviewer gives with the whole corpus in front of them, and `why` is the evidence — a label without one is an opinion. Edit only with a reason recorded here.
notes: The `__all__ +=` blind spot (G3). `MyClass` is exported by the accumulation form and `MyClass.execute` is a public member of it; the kernel exempted the class and not the member, and reported the member dead at `extracted` — the tier whose contract is `safe to act on`. Acting on it deletes public API. Fixed by the `Member of an exported type` exemption in devmap-analyze/liveness.rs.

symbols.why: Public method of an `__all__`-exported class: consumers outside the corpus can call it, so deleting it breaks the declared API.
Called by MyClass.execute (app.py:21). A stdlib-shadowing name, which is the blind spot the fixture probes.
Called by my_func (app.py:16). Also a stdlib-shadowing name.
